settings.label: Worms per team
settings.help: How many worms each side fields. The battlefield is 80 pixels wide - four a side is crowded, which is part of the fun.

settings.label: Starting health
settings.help: Health per worm. A direct hit is worth about 45, so 100 means two good shots and a bit.

settings.label: Allow two-caller matches
settings.help: Whether a caller can host a match for another caller on this board. Turning it off leaves hotseat, which needs nobody else online.
